# hyperlite_iso (Data Source)

An ISO image of the node's library, to install a VM from it (`hyperlite_vm.iso`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperlite_iso" "debian" {
  name = "debian-13.1.0-amd64-netinst.iso"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The file's name (`debian-13.iso`).

### Optional

- `node` (String) The cluster member that holds the image, as on its resource (`local` when absent: the node the provider talks to).

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) When it was added (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) The file's name.
- `size_mb` (Number) Its size, in MB.
